concept_options.title: YouTube Beginner's Journey: The First Upload Nobody Watched
concept_options.hook: I made my first video. Then I checked the views. Almost nothing.
concept_options.visual_approach: Bespoke motion-graphic diary from blank timeline to first upload and iterative improvements; fresh original diagrammatic host/sidekick representations only if designed anew.
concept_options.target_audience: First-time YouTube creators who are starting with little or no budget
key_points: Create one original video before chasing monetization
Read reach and retention rather than blindly guessing
Explain YPP milestones without promise of income
Production automation should support an original story
concept_options.core_message: Your first video is a starting point; learn, improve, and publish something genuinely yours.
concept_options.cta: Write the one lesson you wish you knew before your first upload.
concept_options.why_this_works: Pairs real 2026 beginner frustration with actionable, verifiable YouTube metrics and policy guidance.

concept_options.title: What YouTube Monetization Actually Requires
concept_options.hook: The first monetization milestone isn't what most new creators think.
concept_options.visual_approach: Original typography-led eligibility diagrams, layered progress meters, no sourced imagery or characters from previous episodes.
concept_options.target_audience: Beginners confused by YouTube Partner Program thresholds
key_points: Distinguish expanded YPP from ad sharing
Explain valid Shorts and watch-hour counts
concept_options.core_message: Eligibility is conditional; there is no guaranteed income.
concept_options.cta: Check your current eligibility inside the Earn tab.
concept_options.why_this_works: Directly addresses measurable misinformation found in monetization beginner questions.

concept_options.title: Make Your First Original YouTube Video for Zero Dollars
concept_options.hook: What if every paid editing and AI service disappeared tomorrow?
concept_options.visual_approach: Fresh screen-space vector diagrams with open-source asset paths, project checklists and synthetic creative process visuals; no old art assets.
concept_options.target_audience: Creators without a PC or paid software budget
key_points: Research first and build a clear script
Use original graphics and free local composition tools
Review audio and captions before publishing
concept_options.core_message: A thoughtful workflow matters more than expensive generation tools.
concept_options.cta: Plan a 30-second original hook before buying tools.
concept_options.why_this_works: Addresses the cost pressure and originality requirements while showing an achievable workflow.

selected_concept.rationale: Producer recommendation only; owner approval is still pending. The request was to restart the beginner journey from scratch, with original assets.

production_plan.art_direction: FRESH CONCEPT ONLY: paper-white and deep-navy editorial cards with copper progress paths, on-screen notebook/checklist metaphors and camera-like moves. No legacy character artwork, prior recordings, character shapes, sprites, intro stingers, thumbnail elements, transitions or B-roll. New assets must be designed after approval.

stages.approach: Original, cited research with official YouTube eligibility and community experiences.
Three original editorial concepts, a zero-paid budget, and explicit approval gate.
Write a 10-minute English two-voice documentary script with original dialogue; no old scripts.
New scene-by-scene storyboard with kinetic captions/data and distinct visual rhythm.

tools.why_this_provider: No old voice assets; offline provider has no paid API charge.
No old character sprites, external media or premium generation.

stages.approach: New art, newly generated speech, no existing project assets; provider availability must be verified before approval.
OpenMontage edit decisions and timeline; original cuts and captions.

tools.why_this_provider: Animation-first editorial layouts; do not substitute a legacy composition.
